title: Indian forest, slowed down
caption:
Fifteen seconds of Indian forest. No words needed.

The leopard in the first shot is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.

Source: IUCN Red List (Panthera pardus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
